name: packing-optimizer
description: Optimize item loading into boxes, bins, pallets, and shipping containers with detailed placement plans.

interface.longDescription: Packing Optimizer evaluates available box or bin sizes to calculate an efficient loading plan. Provide item dimensions and candidate bin types to receive a layout with 3D placement coordinates and rotation angles.
defaultPrompt: Pack 50 boxes (40x30x25 cm) into 120x80 cm or 120x100 cm pallets, picking the most space-efficient option
